Proven track record of building and deploying AI solutions thatenhance efficiency, automation, and decision-making. Skilled in designing scalableML/DL/GenAI models that solve real-world challenges with greater business impact.Lead Prediction System: Led development of an automated pipeline to identifypotential leads from user-configured websites using Python, web scraping, andLLMs. Integrated Airflow for weekly alerts, reducing manual monitoring andaccelerating lead discovery.Risk Prediction for Tenders: Built a risk detection model using existing libraries,Advanced RAG, and LLM agents to analyze historical tender data, improving earlyrisk identification and enabling faster, data-driven decisions.RFQ Automation Platform: Architected an end-to-end system to automateprocurement identification and RFQ generation, extracting and summarizingprocurement information across all pages using LLM- and agent-based pipelines.Integrated a chatbot interface to answer user queries on tender projects, reducingprocessing effort and turnaround time.LLM-Powered Search Engine: Developed an intelligent chatbot for 15,000+unstructured documents, designed for senior decision-makers to efficientlyretrieve information from past tenders. Leveraged Databricks, custom sectiondetection, and intelligent chunking to improve search accuracy and relevance.AI Auto-Completion System: Built a GPT-powered feature that recommendsresponses dynamically as users type, improving accuracy, speeding up drafting,and assisting users in generating or modifying answers directly in the answer box.RAG-Based Response Assistant: Implemented GPT-powered features for first-draft generation, summarization, proofreading, and readability enhancementusing RAG pipelines, enabling users to draft or modify responses in real time,resulting in faster and higher-quality RFQ response creation.Enhanced Recommendation Engine: Upgraded the recommendation pipeline byintegrating Ada embeddings with larger embedding dimensions than BERT,achieving 60% improvement in accuracy and relevance for RFP suggestions.Document Summarization: Developed a hybrid summarization pipelinecombining BERT-based extractive techniques with GPT models to generateconcise, high-quality summaries that capture critical content efficiently.Document Analysis & Requirement Detection: Built an NLP-driven system usingopen-source libraries to extract key information (dates, sections, locations,organizations, job titles, laws, monetary values, names, percentages, contactdetails, URLs, domain-specific keywords) and fine-tuned BERT/T5 for sentenceclassification to automate question/statement identification, achieving 85%efficiency improvement.Answer Snippet Extraction: Designed a SQuAD fine-tuned BERT model to retrievethe most contextually relevant portions of answers from large unstructureddocuments, eliminating manual navigation and speeding up information retrieval.Important Keyword Extraction: Implemented an algorithm leveraging SpaCy,NLTK, TextRank, RAKE, YAKE, KeyBERT to extract meaningful, domain-specifickeywords, enhancing search functionality and retrieval accuracy.Recommendation Engine: Designed an ML-powered retrieval pipeline using BERTvector embeddings and similarity search to suggest the most relevant questionsfrom a database, increasing efficiency in responding to RFPs.+91 EDUCATIONB.E ECE - BIT Sathy, India.2016 - 2020Person Footfall Prediction in Retail Stores: Developed a custom person re-identification module with OSNet integrated with YOLO/RT-DETR person detectionto reduce identity switches and improve tracking continuity. Used the system tomeasure footfall, identify high-traffic areas, and predict customer productinterest, enhancing retail layout, marketing strategies, and customer analytics.Vehicle Detection & License Plate Tracking: Developed vehicle detectionpipelines using YOLOv8. Combined with LLM-powered OCR (e.g., Gemini) todetect and log license plates, enabling automated monitoring, security, andhistorical analytics in industrial environments.Gender & Customer Analytics: Built models to track person in/out counts andgender classification from CCTV footage, providing insights into customerdemographics and supporting retail marketing and sales strategies.Face Recognition for Attendance Monitoring: Developed a face recognition-based attendance system using YOLO-Face for detection and a custom ResNet-based feature extractor, enabling accurate workforce check-ins.Vehicle Speed Detection in Industrial Environments: Deployed a real-timevehicle speed detection system, calibrating camera distance and perspectiveusing homography and object detection for reliable speed estimation.PPE Detection for Industrial Safety: Built an end-to-end pipeline for detectinghelmets, vests, and gloves. Curated and annotated datasets using LabelImg andRoboflow and trained YOLOv8m, ensuring compliance monitoring in safety-critical zones.Industrial Hand Monitoring via Pose Estimation: Designed a rule-based systemusing MediaPipe and YOLO-Pose to monitor hand positions near machinery,enabling early detection of unsafe gestures and accident prevention.Action Recognition for Retail Theft Detection: Built LSTM-based temporal modelsto identify suspicious behaviors, contributing to automated security alertsystems.Video Question-Answering (R&D) using NVIDIA Metropolis: Developed a real-time Video QA system leveraging the NVIDIA Metropolis platform, enabling usersto ask questions about live video streams for industrial and retail analytics.M.Tech AI and ML - BITS Pilani, India.2025 - present
